# Jayrun 0.3.5

An iterative context can now keep a rolling window of native history while it runs. Set `ContextSettings(max_iterations=None, execution_history_limit=8)` to retain detailed step reports for eight reported graph iterations. Snapshot and report totals cover the whole run, including evicted iterations. The default keeps full detail.

**Breaking change for callers that set retention limits.** Use `ContextSettings(record_policy=RecordPolicy(history_per_key=4))` for application values. Use `EngineSettings(terminal_history_policy=TerminalHistoryPolicy(max_entries=128))` for finalized summaries across contexts. All numerical defaults carry forward, and the engine’s lifetime admission budget remains independent. Upgrade snapshot-exchanging workers together. Existing SQLite history remains readable with its recorded fields.

[Capacity and retention](https://jayrun.readthedocs.io/en/latest/guides/runs/capacity.html) · [Settings reference](https://jayrun.readthedocs.io/en/latest/reference/settings.html) · [Migration from the six flat settings](https://github.com/jayrun-project/jayrun/blob/v0.3.5/CHANGELOG.md)
